title: From Pretty to Evaluate
description: Transform the pretty printer into an evaluator by replacing print statements with return statements, showing how tree walks can do different work.

steps.description: Reveal imports: traceback, dataclasses, and typing.
Reveal node classes: simplified Num and BinOp dataclasses.
Reveal OPS: dictionary mapping operator symbols to arithmetic functions.
Reveal evaluate: match on node type, return values for leaves, recursively compute for BinOp.
Reveal tests: tree1 and tree2 with try-except for error handling.
Focus on Num case: returns the value directly instead of printing.
Focus on BinOp case: recursively evaluates children then applies operator.
